subject: Novamed - EU-only transfer mapping & operational evidence request
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novamed.it>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: legal@novamed.com
Date: 2028-04-22T09:15:00Z
Subject: Request: evidence of EU-only processing & transfer map for procurement

Hi Karthik,

Thank you for the demo last week. Procurement and legal are preparing our security annex and we need firm evidence that customer data for the NovaMed integration will be processed only within the EU (including backups, logs, and operator access). Specifically they asked for:  

- A transfer mapping showing all systems (control plane, inference nodes, backups, analytics) and their geographic locations.
- Confirmation about KMS keys: are they EU-resident or can we use our own CMK in an EU HSM?
- How long backups/archives are retained and proof of deletion procedures (including snapshot/replica retention).
- Whether Redwood operators (support/infra) can access content and under what conditions; audit log evidence.
- If SCCs are required as part of contract, what evidence bundle and timeline you can provide.

We need to review this ahead of our legal sign-off next week. Can you provide an operational evidence pack or a short attestation your team can sign?

Thanks,
Elena

--
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement, NovaMed
elena.rossi@novamed.it
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novamed.it>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-22T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: evidence of EU-only processing & transfer map for procurement

Elena — thank you, and glad the demo was helpful. We can provide the materials you asked for; Ive attached a concise EU processing checklist to start and sketched the required evidence types. Short answers up front:  

- Transfer map: yes, we can provide an architecture map showing control plane, inference hosts, backups, and logging locations.
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own) via EU KMS/HSM for Private deployments; hosted customers can use EU-resident keys when configured on a dedicated plan.
- Backups & retention: backups are stored in-region for EU-only deployments; retention policy is configurable per-customer (default 30 days) and we can produce deletion logs.
- Operator access: operator access to content is restricted and logged; we can export audit trails showing access events and RBAC changes.
- SCCs: we can negotiate SCCs and provide an evidence bundle (logs, key custody docs, backup manifests).

Next steps I propose:  
1) Internal confirmation from our infra/ops on exact backup shard locations and proof artifacts (Naomi, can you confirm and attach the location map?).
2) Engineering note on operator access model and log export format (Soojin, can you add the details).
3) Ill draft an attestation template we can sign and send via DocuSign.

Attaching: redwood-eu-processing-checklist.pdf (summary + required artifacts)

Ill follow up with the detailed evidence bundle by Wednesday.

Best,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

On Apr 22, 2028, at 11:02, karthik_iyer@redwood.com wrote:
> Attaching: redwood-eu-processing-checklist.pdf (summary + required artifacts)

Elena / Karthik — quick technical context from infra:  

1) Deployment modes: 
- Private (VPC/on-prem) — full control plane and inference hosts in-customer VPC. All persistent storage and backups remain in the customers region.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity) — pools can be provisioned in EU regions only; control plane endpoints for management can be colocated in EU on request.
- Hosted API — default control plane is in our managed EU region for customers who opt into EU-only; however some ancillary services (billing/analytics) by default route to our central telemetry cluster unless disabled.

2) Backups & snapshots: 
- For EU-only and Private deployments, snapshot blobs are written to EU object storage buckets with S3 server-side encryption.
- Retention is policy-driven; we expose retention windows in the Console and can set a purge workflow (we retain deletion manifests for audit).
- Proof of deletion: we can provide object lifecycle deletion logs, storage access logs, and manifests showing removed snapshot IDs and timestamps.

3) KMS & keys: 
- Customer-managed keys (BYOK) supported via common EU KMS providers (Azure KeyVault in EU, AWS KMS with EU key material, or HSM on-prem).
- If customers do not bring keys, we can provision EU key material for dedicated/private customers and provide rotation/audit logs.

4) Operator access & audit: 
- Support/ops access requires JIT approval for private deployments and is logged in our SIEM.
- We can export the relevant audit slices (who/when/why) for a given timeframe.

5) SCCs & Schrems II: 
- We recommend SCCs for hosted arrangements where data exporters/importers cross legal jurisdictions; we provide a mapping of subprocessors and a legal questionnaire to support legal review. Evidence bundle will include subprocessor list, access logs, KMS custody documentation, and backup manifests.

Im attaching a simple map (backup-location-map.png) and will pull the manifest for NovaMeds pilot project once I have the account ID.

Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novamed.it>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: legal@novamed.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-23T07:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: evidence of EU-only processing & transfer map for procurement

Karthik/Naomi — thanks, this is helpful. A few clarifications from legal:  

- Procurement needs a signed attestation that (1) primary inference processing and backups for the NovaMed account will be located only in the EU, and (2) in the event of a live legal request from a non-EU authority, Redwood will notify NovaMed and follow the agreed escalation path.
- Can you provide a sample deletion manifest (with sample IDs redacted) showing how you evidence deletion of backups and the retention purge timeline?
- We also need to confirm whether telemetry/analytics can be disabled for our account (we prefer to keep telemetry off for now).

If you can share the attestation and a sample manifest today, procurement can accelerate approval.

Best,
Elena
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novamed.it>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-24T10:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: evidence of EU-only processing & transfer map for procurement

Elena — Ive drafted an attestation and attached the MTAP (mutual transfer and processing) template for legal sign-off (redwood-mtap-template.docx). Key points:  

- Attestation will state: primary inference compute, persistent stores, backups and audit logs for the NovaMed account will be hosted in EU regions only for the duration of the contract, subject to configuration options agreed in the SOW.
- We will provide a deletion manifest export within 72 hours of a retention purge and maintain deletion manifests for 12 months as part of the evidence bundle.
- Telemetry/analytics: we can disable telemetry ingestion for NovaMed on request; disabled means we will not send analytics to our centralized cluster and will keep only aggregate billing metrics required for invoicing.
- Live legal requests: we will notify NovaMed within 48 hours and follow the escalation and legal support path; specifics to be captured in the incident response annex.

Next actions:  
1) Jordan — can you open the procurement playbook and push the MTAP to DocuSign (Ive included the link below)?
2) Soojin — please prepare a sample deletion manifest (redacted) and the audit export format so we can attach it to the MTAP.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example/sign/MTAP-8891

Ill send the signed attestation once legal signs off internally.

Thanks,
Karthik
